caseNameFull: Illinois Central Railroad Co. v. Coussens, Administratrix
attorneys: James L. Byrd was on the stipulation for petitioner. With him on the petition were Joseph H. Wright and John W. Freels.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Mississippi. July 26, 1955. Dismissed per stipulation pursuant to Rule 60 of the Rules of this Court.
